+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Require identical saved states/probes and retry decisions after flag batching."""

+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+OUT = HERE / "validation"
+
+
+def run(name, cone=False):
+    path = OUT / f"{name}.cfg"
+    config = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if "=" in line)
+    baseline = Path(config["output_dir"])
+    alternate = OUT / f"{name}_async"
+    config["output_dir"] = str(alternate)
+    target = OUT / f"{name}_async.cfg"
+    target.write_text("".join(f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in config.items()))
+    executable = HERE / ("mhd_cuda_fp32_async_cme" if cone else "mhd_cuda_fp32_async")
+    subprocess.run([str(executable), "--config", str(target)], check=True, timeout=300)
+    snapshots = sorted(baseline.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))
+    assert snapshots, baseline
+    for source in snapshots:
+        assert np.array_equal(np.load(source), np.load(alternate / source.name)), source
+    assert (baseline / "probe.csv").read_bytes() == (alternate / "probe.csv").read_bytes(), "Probe output changed"
+    a = json.loads((baseline / "statistics.json").read_text())
+    b = json.loads((alternate / "statistics.json").read_text())
+    keys = ["steps", "rejected_steps", "first_order_fallback_steps", "minimum_dt_day",
+            "mean_dimensionless_divB", "max_dimensionless_divB", "weighted_dimensionless_divB"]
+    assert all(a[key] == b[key] for key in keys), (a, b)
+    record = {"baseline": str(baseline), "alternate": str(alternate),
+              "snapshot_arrays_identical": True, "probe_bytes_identical": True,
+              "retry_and_diagnostic_statistics_identical": True,
+              "baseline_statistics": a, "alternate_statistics": b}

+    print(name, json.dumps(record), flush=True)
+    return record
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    names = sys.argv[1:] or ["uniform_fp32", "inductive_split_fp32",
+                            "production_coarse_global_fp32", "production_coarse_split_fp32",
+                            "production_cme_coarse_fp32"]
+    results = {name: run(name, cone="cme" in name) for name in names}
